BibleBack Translation

Iklisyastis

Ecclesiastes

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka seini ne baseen te Iklisyastis, insulat te matagseb ne talagpanulu. Kahi te duma ne si Sulumun ka migsulat kayi piru kahi te duma, lein ne etew. Ka etew ne migsulat kayi, mig-ayad-ayad migsuman-suman ke nekey ka igpasabut te umul. Nakita rin ka langun ne neyitabu kayi te ampew te tane ne ware karuan wey ke malised naa ne egsabuten wey eglihad de ka umul kayi te ampew te tane. Migtambag sikandin ne keilangan ne egtahuren ta ka Magbebaye, eg-ikulen ta wey eggale-gale ki te langun ne indasag din kanta tagse aldew. (Ka igpasabut te Iklisyastis iyan ka “talagpanulu.”)

This document (LIT reading) of Iklisyastis, was_written by a wise teacher (not the same word for school teacher). Some think it was Solomon who wrote this but others think, it was another (person). The person who wrote this, thought deeply about the meaning of life. He observed that many things that happen are useless or hard to understand and that life here on the earth will_ just _passing_by. His advice is that we(incl) should honor the Lord (MS Magbabeye), obey Him and enjoy whatever gifts he has_given us(incl) every day. (The meaning of Iklisyastis is “teacher.”)

Ware karuan te langun

There's_no use of everything

11 Seini ka me lalag te matagseb ne anak ni Dabid ne Hari te Hirusalim.

11 These (are) the words of wise who was a child of Dabid the king of Hirusalim.

2 Malised ne egsabuten! Malised ne egsabuten!

2 Hard to understand! Hard to understand!

Malised ne egsabuten ka langun! kahi te matagseb.

All (things) are hard to understand! the wise (one) said.

3 Nekey ka karuan te langun ne impakannekalan te etew kayi te kalibutan?

4 One generation will_be_gone

and will_be_succeeded again by another,

but the earth won't be_changed.

5 The sun rises and this sets again,

6 Egpangalamag ka diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan

and this continues there north (LIT left point);

this just goes_around and returns there where_ it _came_from.

7 Egtulayas diye te dahat ka langun ne me beuhan,

7 All the streams flow there to the sea,

piru kene egkapenu ka dahat;

but the sea won't be_full;

eglibed e man-e ka me beuhan diye te impuunan dan

the streams return again there where_ they _came_from

wey egtulayas e man-e diye te dahat.

and flow again to the sea.

8 Egpakapela seini se langun;

8 All these can_cause_(someone_to_become)_tired;

egpakapela seini.

it can_cause_(someone_to_become)_tired.

Kene egkapelaan ka mata ne egtetengteng

The eye(s) won't be_satisfied to see

wey kene egkapelaan ka talinga ne egpammineg.

and the ear(s) won't be_tired to listen.

9 Ka neyimu e dengan egkeyimu red man-e kuntee.

9 What's been done long_ago will_be_done again now.

Ka neyitabu e dengan egkeyitabu ded man-e kuntee;

really nothing still new we(incl) can see here on earth.

10 Duen naan pad egkeyitabu ne egkakahi ta ne iyam?

10 Is there any event that we(incl) can still speak of as new?

Ware iya, neyitabu e sika te ware ki pad neetew.

Nothing really, that happened already before we(incl) were_born.

11 Warad egpakasuman-suman te neneyitabu e,

11 No (body) can_remember of what_happened already,

wey ke egpakasuman-suman naa te egkeyitabu pad.

or can_think of what_happens still.

Kenad degma seeye egkasuman-suman pad te egpakasubal ne kabuhalan.

Those also can't be remembered any_more by the succeeding generation.

Ka nabaybayaan te matagseb

The experiences (LIT what_have_gone_through) of the wise

12 Sikeddiey ka matagseb ne Hari te Israil

12 I (am) the wise king of Israil

wey diya a mig-ugpe te Hirusalim.

and I live there in Hirusalim.

13 Inggamit ku ka suman-suman ku te pegnengneng te katagseb

and I used my wisdom for investigating of all that happened here on earth.

Ne nanengnengan ku ne ka kalaggew impatapik e te Manama te etew.

And I learned that sorrow is included in man by God.

14 Nakita ku ka langun ne hinimuwan kayi te kalibutan,

this is difficult like chasing(pl) wind.

15 Ka egkapeku kenad egkaketeng,

15 What's bent_over can_ no_longer _be_straightened_out,

wey ka egkalaag kenad egkakita.[fn]

and what's lost can_ no_longer _be_found.[fn]

16 [xr]Nasuman-suman ku,

16 [xr]I realized,

“Dakel ka katagseb ku du te langun ne mighari te Hirusalim;

“My wisdom is bigger than all the ones_who_reigned in Hirusalim;

matagseb a wey mangngateu e pad kandan.”

I'm wiser and expert than them.”

17 Purisu inggamit ku ka suman-suman ku te pegnengneng te katagseb,

17 Therefore I used my mind in knowing for wisdom,

wey te seeye se egpakabusew wey te keungelan,

and for those can_cause_craziness and foolishness,

18 Su emun ke egdakel e ka katagseb ku

18 For when my wisdom is already great

nasi e degma egdakel ka peglungku ku.

my grieving grows also.

Su ka egdakel se katuenan,

For growing in knowledge/skills,

nasi egdakel degma ka kalaggew.

nevertheless sorrow grows also.

21 Nasakat a ne miggale-gale ad,

21 I decided to enjoy_things,

wey mig-eleg-eleg ke nekey ka kahalaan.

and to test what is happiness.

Piru nanengnengan ku ne ware ded man-e karuan te inggimu ku.

But I learned also_that there_is no use of what_ I _did.

2 Ware karuan te pegbayat-bayat,

2 There's_no use of laughing_out_loud,

wey kene egpakameupiya ka peggale-gale.

and enjoying has also no good_in_it.

3 Miggala-gala a te inumen,

3 I had_fun with drink,

yet in_spite of that,

ware naawe ka katagseb ku.

Nakasuman-suman a ne kema ke sika ka amana ne meupiya ne eggimuwen te etew

I made_to_think that this might be the very good_thing that a person does

in his/her short life.

4 [xr]Masulug ka immeyimu ku:

4 [xr]Many_things I caused_to_make:

migpeyimu a te me baley wey migpepamula a te me paras.

I caused_to_make houses and I caused_to_plant grapevines.

5 Migpeyimu a te pinamulaan

5 I caused_to_make a garden

wey migpepamula a te nakalkalasi ne me prutas.

and I caused_to_plant different_kinds of fruits (trees).

6 Migpasusubung a

6 I caused_to_dam_up

so_that what_ I _have_caused_to_plant will_be_watered.

7 [xr]Migbebeli a te me uripen ne lukes wey malitan,

7 [xr]I bought men and women slaves,

wey due me uripen ne miglesut diye te baley ku.

and there were slaves born in my house.

Masulug degma ka me ayam ku

than (those) people who lived in Hirusalim before me.

8 [xr]Migmanlimud a degma te pelata wey bulawan

Masulug ka egpeulahingen ku ne me lukes wey me malitan

9 [xr]Purisu neyimu a ne mabantug

10 Naangey ku ka langun ne igkeupii ku.

Nahala a te langun ne inggimu ku

I was_happy with all that I did

and this is the prize of all that I worked_hard_with.

11 Piru impalemlem ku ka langun ne inggimu ku ne nalasey-lasey a,

11 But meditated on all that I did which I suffered_difficulties,

Nekeiling e re te miglupug te kalamag,

I was_ just _like chasing the wind,

and what_ I _have_worked_hard_with here on earth had_no purpose.

12 Sikan naa ka impeg-iling ku

Su ware egpekeyimu ne egpeg-iling te katagseb, keungelan, wey keumbehan,

Ware karuan te seini se langun;

it's just like I chased the wind.

18 Igkeepes ku ka langun ne impakannekalan ku kayi te kalibutan,

19 Ne hentew ka egpakanengneng ke matagseb

and of my wisdom here on earth.

Ware ded man-e karuan kayi.

There's_no use also of it.

20 Purisu egkaruruhu a te langun

There's_no use of it and this is not good.

22 Nekey ka egkaangey te etew te inlaslasayan din

23 [xr]Su te intiru ne aldew te pegtrabahu rin

Ne minsan ke marusilem

Ware ded man-e karuan kayi.

There_is no use of it also.

25 Su hentew bes ka egpakakeen wey ke egkahale naa

Malised seini ne egsabuten;

Ka timpu te minsan nekey

The time for everything

31 Due timpu para te langun kayi te kalibutan,

31 There's a time for everything in this world,

wey eleg ne aldew te minsan nekey ne egkeyitabu.

and a right day/time for everything that happens.

2 Due timpu te pegkeetew,

2 There's a time to be born,

and there's a time for dying.

Due timpu te pegpamula,

There's a time for planting,

and there's a time for harvesting.

and there's a time for healing.

4 Due timpu te pegsinehew,

7 Due timpu te pegbindas,

8 Due timpu te peggeyinawa,

Due timpu te gubut,

12 Therefore I learned that nothing else is good

13 And the person needs to eat and drink

14 Nakanengneng a ne ka langun

this won't be added_on or taken_some_away.

In-iling te Manama rue, su eyew egkaaldek kandin ka etew.

God made_ it _like that, so_that a person fear him.

15 Ka neyitabu kuntee neyitabu e dengan,

15 What happened now/today it happened already long_ago,

wey ka egkeyitabu pad keureme, neyitabu e dengan,

and what will_happen still in_the_future, it happened already long_ago,

su impalibed-libed de seini langun te Manama.

because God caused_ it all _to_return_around.

Ware eleg ne peggukum kayi te kalibutan

There's_no correct judgment here on earth

16 Ne kene ne sikan de ka nakita ku:

16 And not only that what_ I _saw:

Diye te hukumanan,

There in judging_places,

wey diye te husayanan,

and there in settling_places,

due mareet.

there's bad_thing.

17 Nakakahi a te suman-suman ku,

17 I was_able_to_say to my mind,

“Eggukuman te Manama ka matareng

“God will_judge the righteous

wey ka mareet ne etew

and the bad person

su due timpu te minsan nekey,

for there_is a time for everything,

wey due timpu te peggukum te langun ne himu.”

and there's a time for judging all the work(s).”

18 Nakakahi a man-e te suman-suman ku,

18 I was_able_to_say again in my mind,

“In-el-elehan te Manama ka me etew eyew igpakita kandan

“God tested the people in_order to show them

ne iling de sikandan te me ayam.”

that they are_ just _like domestic_animals.”

19 Su nekeg-iling de ka egpangkusan te me etew

19 For the same ending of the people

wey te me ayam—nekeg-iling de iya ne egpatey.

and of the domestic_animals—same will_die.

Purisu nekeg-iling de iya ka me etew wey ka me ayam.

Therefore the people and the domestic_animals (are) the same.

Eglihad de iya ka langun.

All will_ just _pass indeed.

20 Nekeg-iling de ka egpangkusan te langun.

20 For (there's) only one ending of all.

Migpuun ka etew wey me ayam te tane

The man and domestic_animals came from the ground/soil

wey eglibed ded te tane.

and will_return to the ground/soil.

21 Ware nakanengneng ke eggendiye naa te langit ka panisingan te etew

22 Purisu nanengnengan ku ne iyan meupiya ne eggimuwen te etew

22 Therefore I learned that the good_thing a person will_do

is to be happy with what_ he _does, because that's only his reward.

Su warad e egpakapangguhud kandin

For no_(one)_left (who) is able_to_tell him

what will_happen after he dies.

41 Nakita ku man-e ka pegleig-leig te me etew kayi te kalibutan.

41 I saw also the oppressing of the people here on earth.

Nakita ku ka pegsinehew te nalleig-leig,

I saw the crying of the oppressed,

wey ware egliwang kandan

because the ones_oppressing them had a big authority

wey ware nakabulig kandan.

and no_(one) helped them.

2 Purisu nakakahi a te meupiya pad

2 Therefore I was_able_to_say that it's better

ka migpatey e du te neuyag pad.

the one dead than one_ still _alive.

3 Piru meupiya pad seeye se ware pad neetew.

3 But those who are not yet born are even_better.

Su kene egpakakita te maddeet ne hinimuwan kayi te kalibutan.

For (they) won't see bad actions here on earth.

and heals him who's frowning.

2 Tumana nu ka suhu te Hari,

2 Obey(sg) the command of the king,

su migsaad ka te Manama ne egtumanen nu sikandin.

because you(sg) promised to God that you(sg) obey him.

3 Kene ka iyal-iyal awe diye te tangkaan te Hari;

3 Don't(sg) rush leaving in front of the king;

kene ka duma te seeye se migplanu te mareet kandin,

don't(sg) accompany those who plan evil to_him,

su egkeyimu te Hari ka langun ne igkeupii rin.

because the king can do everything that he desires.

4 Su mabegbeg ka lalag te Hari.

4 For the word of the king is powerful.

Ware egpekeinse kandin, “Mania te iling due ka eggimuwen nu?”

Nobody can ask him, “Why are you(sg) doing like that?”

5 Ware mareet ne egkeyitabu

5 No bad (thing) happens

te etew ne egtuman te suhu din.

to a person who obeys his command(s).

Ka matagseb nakanengneng ke nekey ka eggimuwen te eleg ne timpu

The wise man knows what to do at the correct time

wey egmenuwen din seini te eggimu.

and how he will_do it.

6 Su due eleg ne timpu wey eleg ne paahi te minsan nekey

6 Because there's a right time and right ways for everything

minsan pad te masumpit ne egkeula-ula te etew.

even when the person is experiencing difficulty.

7 Su ware iya etew ne nakanengneng ke nekey ka egkeyitabu keureme,

7 Because indeed no man knows what will_happen in_the_future,

wey ware minsan hentew ne egpakapangguhud te duma ne etew

and nobody can_tell other people

ke nekey ka egkeyitabu.

what will_happen.

8 Ware etew ne egpakabalabag te kamatayen

8 No man can_restrict death

wey ke egpakamalayat naa te umul rin.

or make_ his life _long.

Ware sundalu ne igpeuli ke diye sikandin te gira.

No soldier can be discharged when he is in a war.

Ka mareet ne etew kene egkaluwas te pegkamareet din.

The bad person can't be_saved by his badness.

9 Nakita ku seini langun wey impalemlem ku

9 I saw these all and I reflect

ka langun ne neyitabu kayi te kalibutan.

everything that happened here on earth.

Due etew ne dakel se katenged

There's a person that has a big authority

wey migbayad-bayad te duma ne egkaleig-leig.

and oppressed others who are to_be_taken_advantage_of.

10 Nakita ku man-e ka amana ne mareet ne me etew ne inlebeng.

10 I also saw the very bad people who were buried.

Dengan, layun sikandan egseled wey eglihawang te timplu.

Long_ago, they always go_inside and go_outside the temple.

Piru indayan sikandan diye te siyudad

But they were praised there in the city

ne inggimuwan dan te mareet.

where they made bad_things.

Malised ded man-e seini ne egsabuten.

This is also hard to understand.

11 Ke kene ne due-rue egparusaan ka etew ne nakasale,

11 If the man who committed_wrong won't be_punished right_away,

nasi egsuman-suman ka duma ne eggimu te mareet.

on_the_contrary others will_think to do bad_things.

12 Minsan ke kamasalig eggimu ka makasesale te mareet

12 Even if the sinner does many evil_things

wey egmalayat ka umul rin,

and his life is long,

piru nakanengneng a ne meupiya ka eggingumaan

but I know that the ending is better

te etew ne due kaaldek te Manama.

for the person who have fear of God.

13 Piru kene ne meupiya ka eggingumaan te mareet se hinimuwan

13 But the ending of those with bad actions is not good

wey egmalepet de se umul ran iling te alung

and their life will_be_ only _short like a shadow

su ware sikandan naaldek te Manama.

because they didn't afraid to God.

14 Duen pad man-e malised ne egsabuten kayi te kalibutan:

14 There's more here on earth that's hard to understand:

ka matareng ne etew iyan egpakaangken te legpad te seeye se mareet se hinimuwan,

the righteous man is the one receiving of the punishment for those with bad actions,

wey ka mareet se hinimuwan iyan egpakaangken te unag te seeye se matareng ne etew.

and the one with bad actions is the one receiving of the reward for the righteous man.

Malised seini ne egsabuten.

This (is) hard to_understand.

15 Purisu ka igtambag ku te etew

15 Therefore what_ I _advise to a person

ne eggale-gale te umul rin,

that he enjoy of his/her life,

su ware duma ne meupiya ne eggimuwen din

because there's_no other good that he will_do

iyan de se pegkeen, peg-inum wey peggale-gale.

only just eating, drinking and enjoying.

Te iling due, egpakaheram sikandin te kahalaan

In that way, he can experience happiness

te impakannekalan din te intiru ne umul rin

on what_ he _worked_hard_with in his entire life

ne imbehey te Manama kandin kayi te kalibutan.

which God given to him here on earth.

16 Maaldew wey marusilem kena a egpakalipereng

16 Day and night I can't sleep

ka egpakannekal ne egpakaangken te katagseb

in trying_hard to acquire wisdom

eyew egkasabut ku ka neneyitabu kayi te kalibutan.

so_that I can understand the things_happened on earth.

17 Ne nakita ku ka langun ne inggimu te Manama,

17 And I saw all that God made,

wey ka neneyitabu kayi te kalibutan ne kenad iya egkasabut.

and what_happened here on earth that can't be understood.

Minsan egpataman-taman ka etew eg-ugsi-ugsi,

Even if a person try_hard in searching,

kene din iya egkanengnengan ka langun.

he won't really understand everything.

Minsan pad ke egkahi ka matagseb ne nakasabut sikandin,

Even if the wise (one) say that he understood,

ka malehet ware din iya seini nasabut.

the truth is that he really didn't understand it.

91 Purisu impalemlem ku seini ay-ayari

91 Therefore I reflected on this carefully

wey nasabut ku ne ka me etew ne matareng,

and I understood that (people) who are righteous,

wey matagseb, wey ka me hinimuwan dan, iyan migbuut ka Manama.

and wise, and their actions, it's God who decides.

Piru ware nakanengneng ka etew ke geyinawa naa

But a person doesn't know if it is love

wey ke kabelu ka egkeyingumaan din.

or hatred what_ he _will_arrive_at.

2 Sabeka re ka egpangkusan te langun ne etew;

2 Only one is the ending of all people;

ka matareng wey ka kene ne matareng ne etew,

the righteous and the people who are not righteous,

ka meupiya wey ka mareet,

the good (one) and the bad (one),

ka me etew ne in-isip ne malinis wey ka in-isip ne malindit,

the people who are_considered clean and the ones considered dirty,

ka migpanubad wey ka ware migpanubad.

the (one who) sacrifices and the (one who) doesn't sacrifice.

Nekeg-iling de ka egpangkusan te etew ne matareng wey te makasesale,

The ending of the righteous person and the sinner is the same,

ka etew ne migpahunlibet wey ka ware migpahunlibet.

the person who swore and the (one who) didn't swear.

3 Seini ka egpakataweles te langun ne neyitabu kayi te kalibutan: ka nekeg-iling de ka egpangkusan te langun.

3 This is the (one that) can_cause_to_annoy of all that happened here on earth: it's the same ending of everything.

Ne napenu degma te mareet wey keungelan ka pusung te etew ne duen pad umul

The heart of a person that has life yet is also full of bad_things and foolishness

wey egkataman, egpatey sikandin.

and afterwards, he will_die.

4 Piru ka minsan hentew ne due umul

4 But anyone who has life

duen pad egkapallateng.

still has something to hope for.

Tenged su due lalahen ne migkahi, ka neuyag ne asu

Because there_is a saying that says, a living dog

meupiya pad du te napatey ne liyun.

is better than the dead lion.

5 Su ka duen pad umul nakanengneng ne egpatey sikandin.

5 Because the one with life still knows that he will_die.

Piru warad kaligneepan te napatey e, warad unag din

But the dead (one) has no idea, he has no reward

wey egkalingawan e sikandin.

and he will_be_forgotten.

6 Egkaawe e ka geyinawa rin, ka kabelu din,

6 His love/breath will_be_gone, his anger,

wey ka pegkeimma rin,

and his jealousy,

wey warad labet din te langun ne egkeyitabu

and he won't have part with all that will_happen

kayi te kalibutan te ware egtamanan.

here on earth forever (LIT no ending).

7 Purisu, gale-gale ka te pegkeen wey peg-inum,

7 Therefore, enjoy(sg) eating and drinking,

su sika ka igkeupii te Manama ne eggimuwen nu.

because that is what God desire you(sg) to do.

8 Saluub ka te mateles ne kumbale,

8 Wear(sg) a nice clothes,

wey baluhuwi nu te lana ka ulu nu.

and wipe oil on your(sg) head.

9 Gale-gale ka duma te asawa nu ne inggeyinawaan nu

9 Enjoy(sg) together with your(sg) spouse that you(sg) love

taheed te duen pad umul nu ne malepet

while you(sg) still have a life that is short

ne imbehey te Manama keykew kayi te kalibutan.

that God given to you(sg) here on earth.

Sikan de ka unag nu te impakannekalan nu kayi te kalibutan.

That is your(sg) only reward of what you(sg) worked_hard on earth.

10 Pakannekali nu ka minsan nekey ne egtrabahuwen nu,

10 Strive_hard on whatever_things that you(sg) do,

su diye te inged te me minatey ne egpangkusan nu

because there in the place of the dead where you(sg) end_up

warad e trabahu, kenad egsuman-suman, warad e katagseb

no more_work, no more thinking, no more wisdom

wey warad katuenan.

and no more knowledge.

11 Duen pad man-e nakita ku kayi te kalibutan:

11 There's more that I saw here on earth:

Kene ne layun ne iyan egpakareeg ka meiyal ne egpallahuy,

It's not always the fast runner wins,

wey kene ne layun ne iyan egpakareeg ka manekal te gira.

and it's not always the strong in warring wins.

Kene ne langun ne matagseb due egkakeen wey ke egkaratu naa ka mangngateu

Not all wise_men have food or the expert becomes rich

wey ke egkalapihan naa layun ka due katuenan.

or the skillful will_be_favored.

Su ware egpakanengneng ke nekey ka egpangkusan te hinimuwan te sabeka ne etew wey ken-u seini egkeyitabu.

Because no one knows of what the outcome of a person's acts and when this will_happen.

12 Su ware nakanengneng ka etew ke ken-u sikandin egpatey,

12 Because a person doesn't know when he will_die,

iling te bayaku ne nabitaya wey te isda ne nasaklag.

like a bird caught_in_snare and a fish caught_by_net.

Iling naan ded ka langun ne etew;

All people are_ just _like it;

egsahap te mareet ne timpu ne ware dan sumsumana.

be_caught in bad time that they did not think_of.

Meupiya ka katagseb du te keungelan

Wisdom is better than foolishness

13 Nakita ku man-e kayi te kalibutan

13 I saw also here on earth

ka sabeka ne panunggilingan te katagseb,

one example of wisdom,

ne in-isip ku ne amana ne impurtanti.

which I considered very important.

14 Due sabeka ne deisek ne lungsud ne deisek de ka nangugpe.

14 There's a (LIT one) small town and few residents.

Inlusuran seini te maresen ne Hari wey inlingutan dan seini

This is attacked by a strong/powerful king and they surrounded it

wey migpatetamundu sikandan te tane diye te lenged te matikang wey makepal ne alad ne batu te lungsud.

and they piled_up soil there near the high and thick fence of stone of the town.

15 Piru due mahinged te seeye ne lungsud,

15 But there's a resident in that town,

ne egkaayu-ayu piru matagseb.

who is poor but wise.

Egkapangabangan din perem ka lungsud te katagseb din,

He could_have_saved (wishing) the town by his wisdom,

piru warad iya nakasuman-suman kandin.

but nobody indeed remembered him.

16 Sikan naa ka nakakahi a te meupiya pad ka matagseb ne etew du te makeseg.

16 That's why I was_able_to_say that the wise person is better than (the) strong.

Piru inlelemetan ka matagseb ne etew ne egkaayu-ayu,

But the wise person that's poor was mocked,

wey ware pamineha ka lalag din.

and his words were_ not _listened_to.

17 Meupiya pad ka egpammineg te matagseb ne etew minsan meyimulung se laheng

17 It is better to listen to the wise man even (his) voice is quiet

du te egpammineg te marahing ne laheng te Hari ne egkeungel.

than to listen to a fool king who has loud voice.

18 Meupiya pad ka katagseb du te panganiban.

18 Wisdom is better than a weapon.

Piru ka sabeka ne makasesale,

But one who is sinner,

egpakarereet te masulug ne keupianan.

can_destroy many good_things.

101 Ka deisek ne keungelan egpakarereet te katagseb wey te kabantug

101 The small foolishness can_destroy wisdom and honor

iling te peemut ne egngareg ke egkaamutan te napatey ne langew.

like a perfume smells_bad when (it's) mixed_in with dead fly.

2 Ka matagseb ne etew egkeupian ne eggimu te meupiya,

2 The wise person wants to do good,

piru ka etew ne ungel egkeupian ne eggimu te mareet.

but the foolish person wants to do bad.

3 Minsan te hinipanawan de te ungel

3 Even the walking_style of the fool

egkanengnengan e ne kulang sikandin te meupiya ne suman-suman,

it_will_be_known that he is lack of good thinking,

wey igpapitew rin ne ungel iya sikandin.

and he will_show that he is indeed a fool.

4 Ke egkabelu keykew ka pangulu nu

4 If you(sg) leaders is angry to you(sg)

kene nu engkeri ka trabahu nu;

don't leave_ your(sg) work _behind;

pariralem ke re kema ke egpasayluwen ka nikandin

just low_ yourself _down perhaps he might forgive you(sg)

te dakel ne sale nu.

with your(sg) big sin.

5 Duen pad man-e nakita ku kayi te kalibutan

5 There's more that I saw here on earth

ne kene ne meupiya ne hinimuwan te me pangulu.

which is not good act by leaders.

6 Ka me ungel dakel se me katungdanan

6 The fools have big responsibilities

piru ka me meyaman deisek de se me katungdanan.

but the rich (ones) have little responsibilities.

7 Nakakita a te me uripen ne iyan mig-untud te me kudde

7 I saw slaves who rode on the horses

wey miggipanew re ka me talahuren iling te iyan uripen.

and the honored (ones) just walk as if (they) are slaves.

8 [xr]Ke eglulungag ka,

8 [xr]If you(sg) dig_a_hole,

kema ke sikeykew red ka egkeulug te lungag.

perhaps you(sg) are still the one to fall in the hole.

Ne ke egsuleddu ka te alabat

And if you(sg) get_through the wall

kema ke egkakahatan ka te uled.

perhaps you(sg) might be bitten by a snake.

9 Ke egpangenat ka te me batu

9 If you(sg) lift/carry stones

kema ke egkapalian ka.

perhaps you(sg) might be wounded.

Ne ke egpangguley ka te kayu

And if you(sg) split firewoods

kema ke egsahap ka.

perhaps you(sg) might be_in_danger.

10 Ke kene ne mahalang ka wasey nu,

10 If your(sg) axe is not sharp,

egpakapangeseg ka iya ka eggamit kayi.

you(sg) surely need to use strength in using it.

Purisu, kamanga a nu seini.

So, sharpen it.

Iling sika te katagseb; egpakabulig keykew ne eglampus ka.

That's like wisdom; (it) can help you(sg) succeed.

11 Emun ke wey nud eg-am-amuka ka uled ke nakahatan kad e,

11 If you(sg) were_bitten by a snake before you(sg) tame (it),

warad karuan te peg-amuk-amuk nu.

your(sg) taming has no use anymore.

12 Ka me lalag te etew ne matagseb, egpakameupiya kandin,

12 The words of the wise man, can_cause_good to_him,

piru ka me lalag te ungel, egpakarereet kandin.

but the words of fool, can_destroy him.

13 Keungelan ka bunsuran te guhuren te ungel.

13 Foolishness is the beginning of the story of the fool.

Ne mareet wey keumbehan de iya ka egpangkusan te guhuren din.

And just evil and insanity indeed is the ending of his story.

14 Layun de egpangasak ka ungel.

14 A fool always talk.

Ware iya nakanengneng ke nekey ka egkeyitabu keureme

Nobody indeed knows what happens in future_days

wey hentew bes ka egpakapangguhud kandin ke egpatey e sikandin?

and who is able_to_tell him when he is dead already?

15 Ka migpakannekalan te ungel egpakabeley kandin,

15 The thing that the fool work_hard can_weary him,

purisu kene sikandin egpekeuma te eggendiyaan[fn] din.

therefore he can't reach his place_of_destination.[fn]

16 Mekeyid-u-hid-u ka nasud ne egkabate-bate pad ka Hari,

16 Pitiful is the nation which the king behaves_like_a child,

wey egsahakeen te intiru ne aldew[fn] ka me pangulu.

and the leaders are_feasting the entire day.[fn]

17 Keupianan te nasud ne iyan Hari ka anak te mabantug,

17 Good for the nation which has the child of great_man as king,

wey ka me talahuren egsahakeen te eleg ne timpu,

and the honored_men are_feasting at the correct time,

eyew te peglig-en wey kene ne pegwubug-hubug.

in_order to strengthening and not drunkenness.

18 Ke egpapepehul ka sabeka ne etew ne eg-ayad-ayad te atep te baley rin,

18 If a person becomes_lazy in repairing the roof of his house,

egtihisan seini wey egkewugnak.

it will_drip and will_collapse.

19 Egpakapahale te etew ka pegkeen wey ka peg-inum,

19 Eating and drinking makes a person happy,

wey puun te seleppi egpakabeli sikandin te minsan nekey ne ingkeilangan din.

and from money he can_buy anything that he needs.

20 Kene nu dilusa ka Hari minsan te suman-suman nu re,

20 Don't(sg) curse the king even just in your(sg) mind,

wey ka due egkeyimu minsan te heles de.

or the well-off (LIT has something to do) even just secretly.

Su kema ke due egpakahuhud[fn] kandan

Because perhaps there_is (someone who) could_story[fn] to_them

wey egkatahaan dan ka inlalag nu.

and they will_know what_ you(sg) _said.

Ka eggimuwen te matagseb

The work of the wise

111 Inigusyu nu ka seleppi nu[fn] diye te talipag te dahat

111 Put_ your(sg) money _into_business[fn] there across the sea

su eglihad ka timpu

because time will_pass_by

ne egpakapallateng ka te ginansya.

and you(sg) can_anticipate an investments.

2 Ba-baara nu ka nigusyu nu te pitu wey ke walu naa,

2 Divide your(sg) business to seven or eight,

su ware ka nakanengneng ke nekey ne karereetan ka egkeyitabu kayi te kalibutan.

because you(sg) don't know what calamity may happen here on earth.

3 Ke makepal e ka gapun

3 If the cloud is thick enough

eg-uran e seini.

it will_rain.

Ne ke hendei egkapeled ka kayu

And where the tree falls

diye de seini egpakatetahu.

there it would place.

4 Ka talagbasuk ne egtetahad te kalamag ne eg-uyan te uran

4 The farmer that waits the wind that bring rain

kene egpakapamula.

won't be_able_to_plant.

Ka egbantey te gapun

The one who watches the cloud

kene egpakahaani.

won't be_able_to_harvest.

5 Kene nu egkasabut ka inggimu te Manama

5 You(sg) won't understand God's creation

ne iyan miggimu te langun,

who made everything,

iling degma te ware nu nataheyi ke immenu te egbunsud te umul te bate

just like also_that you(sg) didn't know how the life of child begins

diye te getek te iney rin.

there in the womb of his/her mother.

6 Pamula ka te maselem

6 Plant(sg) in the morning

wey kene ka peeneng-eneng taman te marusilem,

and don't(sg) stop till the evening,

su ware ka nakanengneng ke hendei ka egkeuyag—

because you(sg) don't know which one will_grow—

ka impamula nu te maselem wey ke ka impamula nu naa te marusilem

the one that's you(sg) planted in the morning or the one you(sg) planted in the evening

wey ke egkeuyag naan iya sika se daruwa.

or the two will_ indeed _grow.

7 Meupiya ka malayag wey tetelesi ne egpitawen ka iyam ne aldew ne egsile.

7 Light (is) good and the new day/sun rising (is) beautiful to look_at.

Meupiya iya ke egkeuyag ki pad.

(It is) good indeed if we(incl) are_ still _alive.

8 Purisu ke egmalayat ka umul nu,

8 Therefore if your(sg) life becomes_long,

gale-gale ka tagse aldew taman te neuyag ke pad.

rejoice(sg) every day as long as you(sg) live.

Piru sumsumana nu ne malayat ka timpu

But remember that time is long

diye te lebenganan.[fn]

there in the tomb.[fn]

Eglihad de iya ka langun.

All just passing_by indeed.

Ka tambag te kanakan

The advice of/to (a) young_man

9 Kanakan gale-gale ka te umul nu

9 Young_man rejoice of your(sg) life

taheed te bate ke pad.

while you(sg) are still young.

Himuwa nu ka langun ne igkeupii nu,

Do everything that you(sg) like,

piru tantanuri nu ne eggukuman ka te Manama

but remember that God will_judge you(sg)

te langun ne eggimuwen nu.

in all that you(sg) do.

10 Awaa nu ka kalaggew nu wey kene nu pasakiti ka lawa nu,

10 Remove(sg) your(sg) sorrow and don't(sg) inflict_pain on your(sg) body,

su ka pegkabate wey ka pegkamaagsik-agsik eglihad de iya.

because being_a_child and being_vigorous will_ just _pass_by.

121 Ne tantanuri nu ka miggimu keykew

121 And remember(sg) the (one who) made you(sg)

taheed te kanakan ke pad;

while you(sg) are still young;

te kene pad egginguma ka malised ne timpu

before the difficult time comes

wey egpakakahi ka te,

and you(sg) will_be_able_to_say,

“Wara a nahale te umul ku.”

“I am not happy with my life.”

2 Sumsumana nu ka miggimu keykew

2 Remember(sg) the (one who) made you(sg)

te kene pad egmarusilem ka pegpitew nu te aldew,

before your(sg) looking at the sun/day becomes_dark,

te bulan, te me bituen,

at the moon, at the stars,

wey te kene pad layun egkikibel ka pegpitew nu te langit.

and before your(sg) looking at the sky/heaven becomes_ always _cloudy.

3 Sumsumana nu sikandin te kene pad egkelkelen ka me lisen nu—ne iyan ka migbantey te baley nu;

3 Remember(sg) him before your(sg) leg trembles—the ones guarding your(sg) house;

wey ka pamanayen nu—ne iyan ka mannekal ne me etew.

and your(sg) shoulder—which (are) the strong people.

Sumsumana nu sikandin te kene pad eg-engked eggaling ka ngipen nu—ne iyan ka deisek naan de ne nasame ne suluhuanen nu;

Remember(sg) him before your(sg) teeth stop grinding—which are your(sg) few servants left;

wey te kene pad egpangalap-halap ka mata nu—ne iyan ka migpamintana ne me malitan.

and before your(sg) eyes become_blur—which is the women who look_out_the_window.

4 Sumsumana nu sikandin te kene ke pad egkabengel

4 Remember(sg) him before you(sg) become_very_deaf

wey kene nud e egkamulmuliyan ka dahing te galingan wey ke ka eg-ulahing naa,

and you(sg) can no_longer hear_clearly the sound of the grinding_mill or singing,

piru egpekeenew ka tenged te laheng te me manuk-manuk.

but you(sg) can_wake_up because of the voices of the birds.

5 Sumsumana nu sikandin te kene ke pad egkaaldek ne egkeulug

5 Remember(sg) him before you(sg) become_afraid to fall

wey egkalaggew ne egsahap diye te kelesadda;

and be_afraid to have_accident there on the road;

sumsumana nu sikandin te kene pad egmaangkag ka bulbul nu

remember(sg) him before your(sg) hair become_white

wey te kene ke pad egkahirapan ne egweil-weil

and before you(sg) struggle to move

wey kene kad e eg-iman-iman te meupiya.

and won't desire for good_things.

Sumsumana nu sikandin te kene ke pad eggendiye te lebenganan ne ugpaan nu te ware egtamanan

Remember(sg) him before you(sg) go to the grave which is your(sg) home_place without ending

wey eglungku ka egdamag keykew.

and the one(s)_lamenting for you(sg) will_be_sorrowful.

6 Purisu sumsumana nu ka miggimu keykew

6 Therefore remember(sg) the (one who) made you(sg)

taheed te kanakan ke pad,

while you(sg) are still young_man,

te kene pad egkabugtus ka hiket ne pelata wey te kene pad egkaleney ka bulawan ne yahung.

while the silver cord won't break yet and before the golden bowl breaks.

Kene nu tahari ne egkalupet ka sakeru diye te sakeruwan

Don't wait for the water_container to break there in the water_source

wey egkareetan ka mutun diye te belun.

and the water_wheel is broken there in the well.

7 Ne eglibed ka lawa nu diye te tane ne impuunan due

7 And your(sg) body will_return to the ground where it came_from

wey eglibed ka panisingan nu diye te Manama ne iyan migbehey keykew due.

and your(sg) spirit will_return to God who gave it to you(sg).

8 “Ware karuan te langun,” kahi te matagseb ne etew.

8 “There's no use of everything,” the wise man said.

“Ware iya karuan te langun.”

“Everything has no use indeed.”

Katammanan

Ending

9 Angin e ne meupiya ne egpanulu ka matagseb,

9 Besides that the wise_man is good at teaching,

impanulu din pad iya man-e te me etew ka natuenan din.

he also taught to the people what_ he _learned.

Innengnengan din, impalemlem din

He learned (it), he meditated on_it

wey inteil rin ka masulug ne me lalahen.

and he set many sayings.

10 Migpakannekal miggamit te me meupiya ne me lalag te pegsulat din ka matagseb

10 The wise (ones) strove_hard using good words in writing

wey layun din igparibabew ka kamalehetan.

and he always put_up the truth.

11 Ka me lalag te matagseb ne etew

11 The words of the wise person

iling te maliddus ne kayu ne eggamiten te me talagbantey

is like a sharp_pointed wood/tree being used by the guards

eyew te pegpanulu te me karniru.

in_order to train the sheep.

12 Mengeanak, bantayi nu man-e seini:

12 Child, take_note also on this:

Ka pegsulat te me libru kene egkataman,

Writing of books has no ending,

wey ka subla ne peg-ugsi-ugsi egpakabeley.

and excessive learning is exhausting.

13 Ka katamanan te langun ne narineg nu:

13 The ending of all you(sg) heard:

Kaaldeki nu ka Manama

Fear(sg) God

wey tumana nu ka me suhu din

and obey(sg) his commands

su sika ka katungdanan te tagse etew.

because that is the responsibility of every person.

14 Su eggukuman te Manama ka langun ne hinimuwan,

14 Because God will_judge all the deeds,

wey ka nekeeles de ne himu,

and the hidden acts,

meupiya ma seini wey ke mareet naa.

may it be good or bad.
